reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkBudgetCategories helper well, but ignores the tree's existing `notes` table (keyed by id, where group notes are stored) and adds a new category_groups.notes column via migration to read the #fixed tag from.

duplication.why: All exclusion rules live in the one bulk-category filter used by every month-wide action; the only duplication is a second storage location for group notes rather than duplicated logic.

placement.why: The selection rule sits correctly in budget/actions.ts, but step 3 is solved with a schema migration, DB/entity/API type changes, and an AQL field added to the categories schema (not category_groups), which pushes the change into the data model for no reason.

scope.why: Beyond the actions, it adds a migration, a categories AQL schema field, DbCategoryGroup/CategoryGroupEntity fields and an API model field that none of the requests asked for.

maintainability.why: The helper is clean and every action shares it, but a parallel notes column that the notes UI never writes is a trap for maintainers, and the long unformatted setZero signature hints at a rushed edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories reads g.notes from a new category_groups.notes column instead of the existing notes table (notes.id = group id) that holds group notes.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the exclusion rules are added once inside getBulkBudgetCategories.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories replaces its includeHidden flag with includeHiddenCategories (no net new parameter), takes the template and #fixed rules as general conditions, and every month-wide action including the new setLastMonthSpending calls it.
